name: Web Session Recorder
description: Record a user-guided browser session and export a Markdown timeline plus a structured event log.

display_description.en: Capture real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic from a user-driven browser session, then emit report.md and events.jsonl to help reverse-engineer web flows and build API-level skills.
display_description.zh: 记录用户真实操作的浏览器会话中的点击、输入、导航与网络请求，导出 report.md 时间线和 events.jsonl 事件日志，用于还原网页流程、构建 API 级技能。

default_init_input.zh: 记录我在以下网址的浏览器会话：

quick_inputs.zh: 记录我在以下网址的浏览器会话：

quick_inputs.en: Stop the current recording and summarize the timeline
quick_inputs.zh: 停止当前记录并总结时间线

quick_inputs.en: Attach to my already-running Chrome (http://127.0.0.1:9222) and record
quick_inputs.zh: 接入我已在运行的 Chrome（http://127.0.0.1:9222）并记录

display_description.en: Launch or attach to a browser and start capturing the session.
display_description.zh: 启动或接入浏览器并开始捕获会话。

display_description.en: Stop the session and write report.md and events.jsonl.
display_description.zh: 停止会话并写出 report.md 与 events.jsonl。

display_description.en: List active recording sessions and live event counts.
display_description.zh: 列出进行中的记录会话与实时事件计数。
